profiles.name: Samsung (One UI)

cautionPackages.com.samsung.android.scloud: Removing breaks Samsung Cloud backup and Smart Switch synchronization.
cautionPackages.com.samsung.android.themestore: Removing breaks custom One UI themes and icon packs.
cautionPackages.com.samsung.android.app.routines: Removing disables Modes and Routines automation.
cautionPackages.com.samsung.android.smartswitchassistant: Removing breaks cable/wireless migration via Smart Switch.

profiles.notes: Knox core components, Samsung Account (com.osp.app.signin), and IMS telephony services must never be removed.

profiles.name: Xiaomi / Redmi / POCO (MIUI & HyperOS)

cautionPackages.com.miui.daemon: Telemetry daemon; removing is common on MIUI but can affect battery stats on some HyperOS builds.
cautionPackages.com.miui.cloudservice: Required for Mi Cloud sync; do not remove if Mi Account sync is active.
cautionPackages.com.xiaomi.xmsf: Xiaomi Service Framework; removing breaks push notifications for MIUI system apps.

profiles.notes: CRITICAL: Never remove com.miui.securitycenter, com.xiaomi.finddevice, or com.xiaomi.account on MIUI/HyperOS—doing so causes an immediate bootloop requiring recovery wipe.

profiles.name: OPPO / Realme / OnePlus (ColorOS / Realme UI / OxygenOS)

cautionPackages.com.heytap.cloud: Breaks HeyTap Cloud backup and photo sync.
cautionPackages.com.coloros.smartsidebar: Disables the Smart Sidebar floating panel.

profiles.notes: ColorOS, Realme UI, and OxygenOS 12+ share the Oplus framework. Require 'Disable Permission Monitoring' enabled in Developer Options for ADB commands.

profiles.name: Vivo / iQOO (OriginOS)

cautionPackages.com.vivo.abe: Abnormal Behavior Engine (AI power & thermal scheduling); can be frozen for extra performance, but may affect dynamic frame rate scaling.
cautionPackages.com.vivo.weather: OriginOS Atomic weather widgets and lock screen climate info.
cautionPackages.com.vivo.assistant: Jovi Voice Assistant and smart suggestion cards.
cautionPackages.com.bbk.theme: iTheme Theme Store; disabling prevents changing custom OriginOS fonts and icon packs.
cautionPackages.com.vivo.appstore: V-Appstore; required for official OTA updates of pre-installed Vivo system apps.

profiles.notes: OriginOS requires com.bbk.account, com.vivo.launcher (Atomic Desktop), and com.vivo.permissionmanager to remain intact. Extensive background logging daemons (bbklog, logsystem, nps, epm, networkimprove) can be safely disabled.

profiles.name: Vivo / iQOO (FuntouchOS)

cautionPackages.com.vivo.abe: Abnormal Behavior Engine; AI performance daemon.

profiles.notes: Vivo Global FuntouchOS devices protect com.bbk.account and com.vivo.permissionmanager; removing them causes boot or activation lockouts.

profiles.name: Google Pixel / Motorola / Nothing / Sony / Asus (AOSP-derived)

cautionPackages.com.google.android.as: Android System Intelligence (Live Caption, Now Playing, Smart Autorotate).
cautionPackages.com.motorola.actions: Moto Actions gestures (chop for flashlight, twist for camera).

profiles.notes: Standard AOSP rules apply. Ensure at least one launcher, browser, dialer, SMS app, and input method remain enabled.

profiles.name: Android TV & Google TV (Chromecast, Sony Bravia, TCL, Hisense, Shield TV)

cautionPackages.com.google.android.katniss: Google Assistant on TV; disabling turns off remote microphone voice search.
cautionPackages.com.google.android.tungsten.setupwraith: TV initial setup wizard; safe to disable only after initial setup is complete.

profiles.notes: Inspired by CleanYourTV (Gathin23/cleanyourtv). Disables sponsored home-screen rows, Google TV movie store ads, and vendor ACR tracking (Samba TV) over Wi-Fi while preserving HDMI inputs, Chromecast (mediashell), and remote pairing.

profiles.name: Xiaomi / Redmi TV (PatchWall OS)

cautionPackages.com.mitv.tvhome: PatchWall default TV launcher; disable only if an alternative launcher (e.g. Projectivy Launcher or CleanYourTV Minimalist Launcher) is installed and set as default.

profiles.notes: PatchWall TV injects ad rows and upgrade prompts. Disabling com.xiaomi.mitv.advertise strips ad banners.

profiles.name: Amazon Fire TV (Fire OS)

cautionPackages.com.amazon.vizzini: Amazon Voice/Alexa service on Fire TV.

profiles.notes: Disables Amazon ad manager and telemetry services over ADB while maintaining Fire TV remote and core settings.
